request.input:
Blood request c19 from a hospital.
Hospital note: "Monthly restock: 10 units O-negative. No active cases. All ward patients are typed Rh-positive."
Parsed by code from the note: blood group O-, units 10.

questions.instructions: The note says the patients who will receive this blood are Rh-positive (or of a group that can receive O+), so O+ red cells could be given instead of the O- requested.
questions.name: substitution_ok
